climate: Photograph hurricane shutters or impact windows, the roof and the AC unit, and look for water stains; hurricane season and humidity make storm damage and mold common.
fact: Much of Port St. Lucie was laid out in the 1960s as a grid of lots for single-family homes, so most rentals are houses rather than apartments.
